when: A matrix. Maths chapter 3 carries 496 of them.
signals: two or more consecutive lines of ASCII matrix art: [ 3  -2  1 ]
notes: Brackets are DRAWN with borders, not typed as [ ] glyphs, so they grow with the number of rows. Cells are a CSS grid with tabular numerals, so columns line up. A matrix is the one construct where losing the brackets loses the meaning: without them a 2x3 matrix is six loose digits. The same element also renders the INLINE matrices that format/inline builds inside a .m run; `matrix_art` is the block form, where each source line is one matrix row.
